telco.parquet.source: IBM Telco customer churn sample dataset (Cognos Analytics sample data)
telco.parquet.cleaning: TotalCharges blanks -> null; churned = Churn == 'Yes'; columns otherwise as-is

lung.csv.source: NCCTG lung cancer data (Loprinzi et al., 1994), R survival::lung
lung.csv.cleaning: dots in column names -> underscores; event = (status == 2)

gbsg.csv.source: German Breast Cancer Study Group (Schumacher et al., 1994), R survival::gbsg
gbsg.csv.cleaning: rownames dropped; event = status (1 = recurrence or death)
